scope: we performed a quantitative mass spectrometry-based proteomics analysis in gastrocnemius skeletal muscle biopsies

Skeletal muscle biopsies were transferred into 500 μl of ABC-buffer (ammonium-bicarbonate buffer, 100 mM, pH 8.0) containing 0.5% sodium deoxycholate. Proteins were extracted using a Precellys Evolution homogenizer in combination with 2.8 mm metal beads for 3 × 30 s.
